name: Hungary
famous_for: Budapest Parliament building along the Danube, natural thermal baths (Széchenyi), spicy Goulash, and Tokaji sweet wine.
tourists: Over 17.5M tourists annually; famous for Buda Castle, Chain Bridge, Lake Balaton, and ruined ruin-bars.
must_know: Clinking beer glasses during a toast was avoided for 150 years in Hungary following the 1849 Austrian execution of martyrs.
fun_fact: Budapest has over 120 natural geothermal springs delivering more than 70 million liters of warm thermal water every day.
